text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Could this be... the "Voice of 
Destiny"——?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
............No, that's not it. It's a 
softer voice, echoing from far away.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It feels like something is warmly wrapping 
around me... Could it be you guys?
